```{r}
############################################################
## Script   : pILC_03_Chromatin_Estrogen_pathway_scores.Rmd
## PURPOSE
##   Chromatin and estrogen pathway scores across 3 RNA clusters,
##   and correlation between chromatin and estrogen pathway scores.
##   All gene sets come from databases (MSigDB: GO, Hallmark,
##   Reactome, KEGG Medicus). No hand-typed gene lists.
## INPUT
##   - VST_data_GENCODEv47/htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv
##   - VST_data_GENCODEv47/gene_annotation_from_GTF.tsv
##   - NMF consensus k=3 GCT (cluster membership)
##   - MSigDB C5 GMT (local) + msigdbr package for the other collections
## NOTE
##   Clusters were derived from the same expression data; results
##   characterize the clusters and are not independent validation.
############################################################
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(data.table)
  library(GSVA)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
  library(msigdbr)
})

# ----------------------------
# Paths (fixed names, no date/time stamps)
# ----------------------------
input_dir  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/VST_data_GENCODEv47"
count_file <- file.path(input_dir, "htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv")
annot_file <- file.path(input_dir, "gene_annotation_from_GTF.tsv")

cluster_gct_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/GenePattern_NMFConsensus/vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct"
c5_gmt_file      <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"

out_dir   <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Chromatin_Estrogen_pathway_scores"
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
plot_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (f in c(count_file, annot_file, cluster_gct_file, c5_gmt_file)) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Input file not found: ", f)
}

# ----------------------------
# Settings
# ----------------------------
min_set_size <- 10
max_set_size <- 500
jaccard_cutoff <- 0.5     # sets overlapping more than this are collapsed
n_top_heatmap <- 20       # top sets per family in the cluster heatmap
n_top_box <- 8            # top sets per family in boxplots
n_top_scatter <- 6        # top correlated pairs shown as scatter plots

cluster_colors <- c("Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77", "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02", "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3")

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
clean_sample <- function(x) sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", trimws(as.character(x)))

read_gmt <- function(file) {
  lines <- strsplit(readLines(file), "\t")
  setNames(lapply(lines, function(v) toupper(v[-(1:2)])),
           vapply(lines, `[`, character(1), 1))
}

zscore_rows <- function(mat, cap = 2.5) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z[z > cap] <- cap
  z[z < -cap] <- -cap
  z
}

save_ht <- function(ht, stem, w, h) {
  for (ext in c("pdf", "png")) {
    f <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, ".", ext))
    if (ext == "pdf") pdf(f, width = w, height = h) else png(f, width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 300)
    draw(ht, merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 6, 4), "mm"))
    dev.off()
  }
}

# ----------------------------
# Clusters from the NMF GCT file
# ----------------------------
cluster_dt <- fread(cluster_gct_file, skip = 2, data.table = TRUE)
membership_col <- grep("^membership", names(cluster_dt), value = TRUE)
if (length(membership_col) != 1) stop("Expected exactly one membership column.")
cluster_dt <- cluster_dt[, .(Sample = clean_sample(Name),
                             Cluster = factor(paste0("Cluster ", as.integer(get(membership_col))),
                                              levels = c("Cluster 1", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3")))]
if (anyNA(cluster_dt$Cluster)) stop("Cluster membership must be 1, 2 or 3.")
if (anyDuplicated(cluster_dt$Sample)) stop("Duplicate samples in cluster file.")
setorder(cluster_dt, Cluster)
print(table(cluster_dt$Cluster))   # expected 10 / 10 / 11
fwrite(cluster_dt, file.path(table_dir, "cluster_metadata.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ----------------------------
# Counts -> DESeq2 -> unsupervised VST (blind = TRUE)
# ----------------------------
count_dt <- fread(count_file, data.table = TRUE)
if (!("Gene" %in% names(count_dt))) stop("Count file needs a 'Gene' column.")
if (anyDuplicated(count_dt$Gene)) stop("Duplicate gene labels in count file.")
count_dt <- count_dt[!grepl("^__", Gene)]

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(count_dt), "Gene")
if (length(setdiff(cluster_dt$Sample, sample_cols))) {
  stop("Cluster samples missing in counts: ", paste(setdiff(cluster_dt$Sample, sample_cols), collapse = ", "))
}
if (length(setdiff(sample_cols, cluster_dt$Sample))) {
  stop("Count samples without cluster: ", paste(setdiff(sample_cols, cluster_dt$Sample), collapse = ", "))
}

count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_dt[, cluster_dt$Sample, with = FALSE])
rownames(count_matrix) <- count_dt$Gene
if (anyNA(count_matrix) || any(count_matrix < 0) || any(count_matrix != round(count_matrix))) {
  stop("Counts must be non-negative integers without missing values.")
}
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"

metadata <- data.frame(Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster, row.names = cluster_dt$Sample)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(count_matrix, metadata, design = ~ Cluster)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3, ]
message("Genes after prefilter: ", nrow(dds))

# blind = TRUE: the cluster labels do not influence the scores tested against them
vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE))

# ----------------------------
# Convert labels to gene symbols (needed to match MSigDB)
# ----------------------------
annot <- fread(annot_file)
sym_dt <- data.table(
  Gene = rownames(vst_mat),
  Symbol = toupper(annot$gene_symbol[match(rownames(vst_mat), annot$Gene)]),
  Mean_VST = rowMeans(vst_mat)
)
sym_dt <- sym_dt[!is.na(Symbol) & !grepl("^ENSG[0-9]+", Symbol)]   # bare ENSG IDs cannot match databases
setorder(sym_dt, -Mean_VST)
sym_dt <- sym_dt[!duplicated(Symbol)]                                # shared symbol: keep the most expressed gene
expr <- vst_mat[sym_dt$Gene, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(expr) <- sym_dt$Symbol
expressed_genes <- rownames(expr)
message("Symbols available for pathway scoring: ", length(expressed_genes))

# ----------------------------
# Gene sets from databases only
# ----------------------------
get_msig <- function(collection, subcollection = NULL) {
  res <- tryCatch(
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = collection, subcollection = subcollection),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(res)) {   # older msigdbr versions use category / subcategory
    res <- tryCatch(
      msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = collection, subcategory = subcollection),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) {
    message("Collection not available in msigdbr: ", collection, " ", subcollection)
    return(list())
  }
  res <- as.data.table(res)
  lapply(split(res$gene_symbol, res$gs_name), function(g) unique(toupper(g)))
}

go_all  <- read_gmt(c5_gmt_file)
go_sets <- go_all[grepl("^(GOBP|GOCC|GOMF)_", names(go_all))]

db_sets <- c(
  go_sets,
  get_msig("H"),
  get_msig("C2", "CP:REACTOME"),
  get_msig("C2", "CP:KEGG_MEDICUS")
)
db_sets <- db_sets[!duplicated(names(db_sets))]

set_source <- fifelse(grepl("^(GOBP|GOCC|GOMF)_", names(db_sets)), "GO",
              fifelse(grepl("^HALLMARK_", names(db_sets)), "Hallmark",
              fifelse(grepl("^REACTOME_", names(db_sets)), "Reactome",
              fifelse(grepl("^KEGG_MEDICUS", names(db_sets)), "KEGG_Medicus", "Other"))))
names(set_source) <- names(db_sets)

# ----------------------------
# Rule-based family assignment on database set NAMES
# (this is the only selection step; every decision is saved in the audit table)
# ----------------------------
estrogen_include <- "ESTROGEN|ESTRADIOL|ESR_MEDIATED"
estrogen_exclude <- paste(c("BIOSYNTH", "METABOL", "CATABOL", "SECRETION", "TRANSPORT",
                            "GLUCURON", "SULFO", "AROMATASE", "HYDROXYLASE", "ANTIESTROGEN"),
                          collapse = "|")

chromatin_include <- paste(c("CHROMATIN", "HETEROCHROMATIN", "EUCHROMATIN", "NUCLEOSOME",
                             "HISTONE.*(ACETYL|DEACETYL|METHYL|DEMETHYL|UBIQUITIN|DEUBIQUITIN|PHOSPH|SUMO)",
                             "(ACETYL|DEACETYL|METHYL|DEMETHYL|UBIQUITIN|DEUBIQUITIN|PHOSPH|SUMO).*HISTONE",
                             "DNA_METHYLATION", "DNA_DEMETHYLATION", "SWI.*SNF", "BAF_COMPLEX",
                             "PBAF", "POLYCOMB", "PRC1", "PRC2", "NURD", "NURF", "INO80", "SWR1"),
                           collapse = "|")
chromatin_exclude <- paste(c("(^|_)RNA_", "MRNA", "RRNA", "TRNA", "RIBOSOM", "METHYLADENOSINE",
                             "N6_METHYL", "PSEUDOURID", "HISTONE_MRNA", "ZYGOTIC", "GERM_CELL",
                             "SPERM", "OOCYTE", "ANTIBODY", "IMMUNOGLOBULIN"),
                           collapse = "|")

audit <- data.table(
  Set = names(db_sets),
  Source = unname(set_source),
  Estrogen_include = grepl(estrogen_include, names(db_sets)),
  Estrogen_exclude = grepl(estrogen_exclude, names(db_sets)),
  Chromatin_include = grepl(chromatin_include, names(db_sets)),
  Chromatin_exclude = grepl(chromatin_exclude, names(db_sets))
)
audit[, Family := fifelse(Estrogen_include & !Estrogen_exclude, "Estrogen",
                  fifelse(Chromatin_include & !Chromatin_exclude & !Estrogen_include, "Chromatin",
                          NA_character_))]
audit[, Original_size := lengths(db_sets[Set])]
audit[, Expressed_size := vapply(db_sets[Set], function(g) sum(g %in% expressed_genes), integer(1))]
audit[, Size_ok := Expressed_size >= min_set_size & Expressed_size <= max_set_size]

cand <- audit[!is.na(Family) & Size_ok]
cat("Candidate sets before redundancy collapse:\n")
print(cand[, .N, by = .(Family, Source)])

# ----------------------------
# Collapse near-duplicate sets inside each family
# Priority: Hallmark > Reactome > KEGG Medicus > GO, then larger sets first
# ----------------------------
priority <- c(Hallmark = 1, Reactome = 2, KEGG_Medicus = 3, GO = 4, Other = 5)
cand[, Priority := priority[Source]]
setorder(cand, Family, Priority, -Expressed_size)

jaccard <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
expressed_sets <- lapply(db_sets[cand$Set], intersect, y = expressed_genes)

cand[, Kept := FALSE]
cand[, Collapsed_into := NA_character_]
for (fam in unique(cand$Family)) {
  kept <- character()
  for (s in cand[Family == fam, Set]) {
    hit <- NULL
    for (k in kept) {
      if (jaccard(expressed_sets[[s]], expressed_sets[[k]]) >= jaccard_cutoff) { hit <- k; break }
    }
    if (is.null(hit)) {
      kept <- c(kept, s)
      cand[Set == s, Kept := TRUE]
    } else {
      cand[Set == s, Collapsed_into := hit]
    }
  }
}

audit <- merge(audit, cand[, .(Set, Kept, Collapsed_into)], by = "Set", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
audit[, Final_decision := fifelse(is.na(Family), "Not chromatin/estrogen by name rule",
                          fifelse(!Size_ok, "Excluded by gene-set size",
                          fifelse(Kept %in% TRUE, "Retained", "Collapsed (redundant)")))]
fwrite(audit, file.path(table_dir, "geneset_selection_audit.tsv"), sep = "\t")

final <- cand[Kept == TRUE]
final_sets <- expressed_sets[final$Set]
set_family <- setNames(final$Family, final$Set)
cat("Final sets retained:\n")
print(final[, .N, by = .(Family, Source)])
if (!all(c("Chromatin", "Estrogen") %in% final$Family)) stop("A family has no retained sets.")

fwrite(final[, .(Set, Family, Source, Expressed_size)],
       file.path(table_dir, "retained_gene_sets.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# Readable labels for figures (IDs stay unchanged in all tables)
clean_label <- function(ids) {
  x <- sub("^(GOBP|GOCC|GOMF|HALLMARK|REACTOME|KEGG_MEDICUS_REFERENCE|KEGG_MEDICUS)_", "", ids)
  x <- tolower(gsub("_", " ", x))
  x <- paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
  x <- gsub("\\bdna\\b", "DNA", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\bprc([12])\\b", "PRC\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\bswi snf\\b", "SWI/SNF", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\bhdacs?\\b", "HDAC", x, perl = TRUE)
  make.unique(paste0(x, " [", set_source[ids], "]"), sep = " #")
}
label_map <- setNames(clean_label(names(final_sets)), names(final_sets))

# ----------------------------
# ssGSEA scores (sample level)
# ----------------------------
if ("ssgseaParam" %in% getNamespaceExports("GSVA")) {
  param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(exprData = expr, geneSets = final_sets,
                             minSize = min_set_size, maxSize = max_set_size, normalize = TRUE)
  scores <- GSVA::gsva(param, verbose = FALSE)
} else {
  scores <- GSVA::gsva(expr = expr, gset.idx.list = final_sets, method = "ssgsea",
                       kcdf = "Gaussian", min.sz = min_set_size, max.sz = max_set_size,
                       abs.ranking = TRUE, ssgsea.norm = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
}
scores <- as.matrix(scores)[, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE]

fwrite(data.table(Set = rownames(scores), Family = set_family[rownames(scores)],
                  Label = label_map[rownames(scores)], scores),
       file.path(table_dir, "ssGSEA_scores.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ----------------------------
# Cluster comparisons (FDR inside each family)
# ----------------------------
score_long <- melt(as.data.table(scores, keep.rownames = "Set"),
                   id.vars = "Set", variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Score")
score_long <- merge(score_long, cluster_dt, by = "Sample", sort = FALSE)
score_long[, Family := set_family[Set]]
score_long[, Label := label_map[Set]]

global_tests <- score_long[, {
  k <- kruskal.test(Score ~ Cluster)
  list(KW_statistic = unname(k$statistic), P_value = k$p.value,
       Median_Cluster1 = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 1"]),
       Median_Cluster2 = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 2"]),
       Median_Cluster3 = median(Score[Cluster == "Cluster 3"]))
}, by = .(Family, Set, Label)]
global_tests[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"), by = Family]
setorder(global_tests, Family, FDR, P_value)
fwrite(global_tests, file.path(table_dir, "cluster_global_tests.tsv"), sep = "\t", na = "")

pair_defs <- list(Cluster2_vs_Cluster1 = c("Cluster 2", "Cluster 1"),
                  Cluster3_vs_Cluster1 = c("Cluster 3", "Cluster 1"),
                  Cluster3_vs_Cluster2 = c("Cluster 3", "Cluster 2"))

pairwise_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(names(pair_defs), function(cmp) {
  p <- pair_defs[[cmp]]
  out <- score_long[Cluster %in% p, {
    x <- Score[Cluster == p[1]]; y <- Score[Cluster == p[2]]
    list(Median_A = median(x), Median_B = median(y),
         Median_difference_A_minus_B = median(x) - median(y),
         P_value = wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)$p.value)
  }, by = .(Family, Set, Label)]
  out[, Comparison := cmp]
  out[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"), by = Family]
  out
}))
setorder(pairwise_tests, Comparison, Family, FDR, P_value)
fwrite(pairwise_tests, file.path(table_dir, "cluster_pairwise_tests.tsv"), sep = "\t", na = "")

# ----------------------------
# Heatmap: top sets per family, grouped by cluster
# ----------------------------
top_sets <- global_tests[, head(.SD, n_top_heatmap), by = Family]
hm_mat <- zscore_rows(scores[top_sets$Set, cluster_dt$Sample, drop = FALSE])

ht_scores <- Heatmap(
  hm_mat, name = "Score Z",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_split = factor(top_sets$Family, levels = c("Chromatin", "Estrogen")),
  column_split = cluster_dt$Cluster, column_order = cluster_dt$Sample,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster,
                                     col = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
                                     annotation_name_side = "left"),
  row_labels = label_map[rownames(hm_mat)],
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_column_names = FALSE, border = TRUE,
  column_title = "Chromatin and estrogen pathway scores by RNA cluster"
)
save_ht(ht_scores, "pathway_scores_cluster_heatmap", w = 15, h = max(8, 0.2 * nrow(hm_mat) + 4))

# ----------------------------
# Boxplots of the top sets per family
# ----------------------------
box_sets <- global_tests[, head(.SD, n_top_box), by = Family]
box_dt <- score_long[Set %in% box_sets$Set]
box_dt[, Label := factor(Label, levels = box_sets$Label)]

box_plot <- ggplot(box_dt, aes(Cluster, Score, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 35)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  labs(title = "Top chromatin and estrogen pathway scores across RNA clusters",
       subtitle = "Ranked by Kruskal-Wallis FDR within each family", x = NULL, y = "ssGSEA score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "pathway_scores_top_boxplots.pdf"), box_plot, width = 16, height = 11)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "pathway_scores_top_boxplots.png"), box_plot, width = 16, height = 11, dpi = 300)

# ----------------------------
# Correlation: chromatin vs estrogen pathway scores
#   Overall: all samples
#   Within-cluster: scores first adjusted for cluster (residuals)
# ----------------------------
chr_ids <- names(set_family)[set_family == "Chromatin"]
est_ids <- names(set_family)[set_family == "Estrogen"]

resid_mat <- t(apply(scores, 1, function(v) resid(lm(v ~ cluster_dt$Cluster))))
colnames(resid_mat) <- colnames(scores)

cor_dt <- data.table(Chromatin_set = rep(chr_ids, each = length(est_ids)),
                     Estrogen_set  = rep(est_ids, times = length(chr_ids)))

cor_res <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(cor_dt)), function(i) {
  a <- cor_dt$Chromatin_set[i]; b <- cor_dt$Estrogen_set[i]
  t_all <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(scores[a, ], scores[b, ], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  t_win <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(resid_mat[a, ], resid_mat[b, ], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  data.table(Rho_overall = unname(t_all$estimate), P_overall = t_all$p.value,
             Rho_within_cluster = unname(t_win$estimate), P_within_cluster = t_win$p.value,
             Shared_genes = length(intersect(final_sets[[a]], final_sets[[b]])))
}))
cor_dt <- cbind(cor_dt, cor_res)
cor_dt[, FDR_overall := p.adjust(P_overall, method = "BH")]
cor_dt[, FDR_within_cluster := p.adjust(P_within_cluster, method = "BH")]
cor_dt[, Chromatin_label := label_map[Chromatin_set]]
cor_dt[, Estrogen_label := label_map[Estrogen_set]]
setorder(cor_dt, FDR_overall, P_overall)
fwrite(cor_dt, file.path(table_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_correlations.tsv"), sep = "\t", na = "")

to_matrix <- function(value_col) {
  m <- matrix(cor_dt[[value_col]][match(paste(rep(chr_ids, each = length(est_ids)),
                                              rep(est_ids, times = length(chr_ids))),
                                        paste(cor_dt$Chromatin_set, cor_dt$Estrogen_set))],
              nrow = length(chr_ids), ncol = length(est_ids), byrow = TRUE,
              dimnames = list(chr_ids, est_ids))
  m
}

draw_cor_heatmap <- function(rho_col, fdr_col, title, stem) {
  rho <- to_matrix(rho_col); fdr <- to_matrix(fdr_col)
  ht <- Heatmap(
    rho, name = "Spearman rho",
    col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
    row_labels = label_map[rownames(rho)], column_labels = label_map[colnames(rho)],
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_names_rot = 60, border = TRUE,
    row_title = "Chromatin pathways", column_title = title,
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
      if (!is.na(fdr[i, j]) && fdr[i, j] < 0.05) grid.text("*", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
    }
  )
  save_ht(ht, stem, w = max(12, 0.45 * ncol(rho) + 9), h = max(9, 0.17 * nrow(rho) + 5))
}

draw_cor_heatmap("Rho_overall", "FDR_overall",
                 "Chromatin vs estrogen scores, all tumors (* FDR < 0.05)",
                 "chromatin_vs_estrogen_correlation_overall")
draw_cor_heatmap("Rho_within_cluster", "FDR_within_cluster",
                 "Chromatin vs estrogen scores, adjusted for cluster (* FDR < 0.05)",
                 "chromatin_vs_estrogen_correlation_within_cluster")

# Scatter plots of the strongest pairs (overall FDR)
top_pairs <- head(cor_dt, n_top_scatter)
scatter_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(top_pairs)), function(i) {
  pair_label <- paste0(top_pairs$Chromatin_label[i], "\nvs ", top_pairs$Estrogen_label[i],
                       "\nrho = ", round(top_pairs$Rho_overall[i], 2),
                       ", FDR = ", signif(top_pairs$FDR_overall[i], 2),
                       "; within-cluster rho = ", round(top_pairs$Rho_within_cluster[i], 2))
  data.table(Pair = pair_label, Sample = cluster_dt$Sample, Cluster = cluster_dt$Cluster,
             Chromatin_score = scores[top_pairs$Chromatin_set[i], cluster_dt$Sample],
             Estrogen_score  = scores[top_pairs$Estrogen_set[i], cluster_dt$Sample])
}))
scatter_dt[, Pair := factor(Pair, levels = unique(Pair))]

scatter_plot <- ggplot(scatter_dt, aes(Chromatin_score, Estrogen_score, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Pair, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  labs(title = "Strongest chromatin vs estrogen pathway-score correlations",
       x = "Chromatin pathway ssGSEA score", y = "Estrogen pathway ssGSEA score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_top_scatter.pdf"), scatter_plot, width = 13, height = 12)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_top_scatter.png"), scatter_plot, width = 13, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# ----------------------------
# Summary, README and provenance (fixed file names)
# ----------------------------
summary_dt <- data.table(
  Metric = c("Samples", "Cluster_1", "Cluster_2", "Cluster_3", "Genes_after_prefilter",
             "Symbols_for_scoring", "Chromatin_sets_retained", "Estrogen_sets_retained",
             "Chromatin_sets_FDR_lt_0.05_across_clusters", "Estrogen_sets_FDR_lt_0.05_across_clusters",
             "Correlation_pairs_tested", "Pairs_FDR_lt_0.05_overall", "Pairs_FDR_lt_0.05_within_cluster",
             "Significant_overall_pairs_sharing_genes"),
  Value = c(ncol(expr), sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 1"), sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 2"),
            sum(cluster_dt$Cluster == "Cluster 3"), nrow(dds), nrow(expr),
            length(chr_ids), length(est_ids),
            sum(global_tests$Family == "Chromatin" & global_tests$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(global_tests$Family == "Estrogen" & global_tests$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            nrow(cor_dt), sum(cor_dt$FDR_overall < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(cor_dt$FDR_within_cluster < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(cor_dt$FDR_overall < 0.05 & cor_dt$Shared_genes > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
)
fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(table_dir, "analysis_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

writeLines(
  c("pILC chromatin and estrogen pathway-score analysis",
    "Seed: 42",
    "Gene sets: MSigDB GO (local C5 GMT), Hallmark, Reactome, KEGG Medicus; no hand-typed gene lists.",
    "Family assignment: keyword rules on database set names (see geneset_selection_audit.tsv).",
    paste0("Set size: ", min_set_size, "-", max_set_size, " expressed genes; sets with Jaccard >= ", jaccard_cutoff, " collapsed within family."),
    "Expression: DESeq2 prefilter (count >= 10 in >= 3 samples), VST with blind = TRUE, ssGSEA (GSVA).",
    "Cluster comparison: Kruskal-Wallis and pairwise Wilcoxon; BH FDR within each family.",
    "Correlation: Spearman, overall and after adjusting scores for cluster; BH FDR across all pairs.",
    "Pairs sharing genes (Shared_genes > 0) are partly correlated by construction.",
    "Clusters were derived from the same expression data; results are not independent validation.",
    "RNA pathway scores show coordinated expression, not causal or mechanistic links."),
  file.path(out_dir, "README_chromatin_estrogen_pathway_scores.txt")
)

writeLines(
  c(paste0("msigdbr version: ", as.character(packageVersion("msigdbr"))),
    paste0("GSVA version: ", as.character(packageVersion("GSVA"))),
    paste0("C5 GMT: ", c5_gmt_file),
    paste0("C5 GMT md5: ", unname(tools::md5sum(c5_gmt_file)))),
  file.path(out_dir, "database_provenance.txt")
)
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))

message("Done. Output: ", out_dir)
print(summary_dt)
```

```{r}
out_dir   <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Chromatin_Estrogen_pathway_scores"
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
plot_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")

score_file  <- file.path(table_dir, "ssGSEA_scores.tsv")
meta_file   <- file.path(table_dir, "cluster_metadata.tsv")
global_file <- file.path(table_dir, "cluster_global_tests.tsv")
cor_file    <- file.path(table_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_correlations.tsv")
for (f in c(score_file, meta_file, global_file, cor_file)) if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing: ", f)

# Settings
n_top_chromatin <- 25          # chromatin sets shown in the bubble plot (estrogen: all)
cluster_colors  <- c("Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77", "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02", "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3")
panel_levels    <- c("All tumors", "Cluster 1", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3")

# ----------------------------
# Read data
# ----------------------------
meta <- fread(meta_file)
meta[, Cluster := factor(Cluster, levels = names(cluster_colors))]

scores_dt <- fread(score_file)
score_mat <- as.matrix(scores_dt[, meta$Sample, with = FALSE])
rownames(score_mat) <- scores_dt$Set
label_map  <- setNames(scores_dt$Label,  scores_dt$Set)
family_map <- setNames(scores_dt$Family, scores_dt$Set)

gt <- fread(global_file)   # Kruskal-Wallis across clusters, FDR inside each family

chr_ids <- names(family_map)[family_map == "Chromatin"]
est_ids <- names(family_map)[family_map == "Estrogen"]

save_plot <- function(p, stem, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
}

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 1: bubble plot, chromatin and estrogen pathways by cluster
# ============================================================

# Z-score each pathway across the 31 tumors, then take the median per cluster
z_mat <- t(scale(t(score_mat)))
z_mat[!is.finite(z_mat)] <- 0
z_long <- melt(as.data.table(z_mat, keep.rownames = "Set"),
               id.vars = "Set", variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Z")
z_long <- merge(z_long, meta, by = "Sample")
bub <- z_long[, .(Median_Z = median(Z)), by = .(Set, Cluster)]

# Choose pathways: all estrogen sets, top N chromatin sets by global FDR
setorder(gt, Family, FDR, P_value)
sel <- rbind(gt[Family == "Chromatin", head(.SD, n_top_chromatin)],
             gt[Family == "Estrogen"])
bub <- merge(bub, sel[, .(Set, Family, Label, FDR)], by = "Set")
bub[, Family := factor(Family, levels = c("Chromatin", "Estrogen"))]
bub[, minus_log10_FDR := -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-10))]

# Row order inside each family: cluster the cluster-level profiles
row_levels <- unlist(lapply(c("Chromatin", "Estrogen"), function(fam) {
  w <- dcast(bub[Family == fam], Label ~ Cluster, value.var = "Median_Z")
  m <- as.matrix(w[, -"Label"]); rownames(m) <- w$Label
  rownames(m)[hclust(dist(m))$order]
}))
bub[, Label := factor(Label, levels = rev(row_levels))]

fwrite(bub[order(Family, Label)], file.path(table_dir, "bubble_plot_data.tsv"), sep = "\t")

bubble_plot <- ggplot(bub, aes(Cluster, Label, fill = Median_Z, size = minus_log10_FDR)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(Family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Median score\n(Z across tumors)") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10 FDR\n(3-cluster test)",
                        limits = c(0, 2.5),                      
                        breaks = c(0.5, 1.3, 2),
                        labels = c("0.5", "1.3 (FDR 0.05)", "2"),
                        range = c(2, 9)) +
  labs(title = "Chromatin and estrogen pathway scores across pILC RNA clusters",
       subtitle = "Colour: relative score in the cluster; size: Kruskal-Wallis FDR (same for every cluster in a row)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "ssGSEA on blind VST. FDR computed within each family. Clusters were derived from the same expression data.") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",                            # NEW: title starts at the figure edge
        plot.caption.position = "plot",                          # NEW: caption starts at the figure edge
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8))

save_plot(bubble_plot, "chromatin_estrogen_bubble_by_cluster",
          w = 14, h = max(8, 0.24 * nrow(unique(bub[, .(Label)])) + 3))   # NEW: w = 14

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 2: correlation, all tumors (main result) and cluster-wise (descriptive)
# ============================================================

cor_one <- function(x, y) {
  t <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  list(Rho = unname(t$estimate), P_value = t$p.value)
}

# CJ with sorted = FALSE: chromatin is the outer index, estrogen the inner index
pairs_dt <- CJ(Chromatin_set = chr_ids, Estrogen_set = est_ids, sorted = FALSE)

res <- rbindlist(lapply(panel_levels, function(panel) {
  samples <- if (panel == "All tumors") meta$Sample else meta$Sample[meta$Cluster == panel]
  out <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs_dt)), function(i) {
    cor_one(score_mat[pairs_dt$Chromatin_set[i], samples],
            score_mat[pairs_dt$Estrogen_set[i],  samples])
  }))
  out <- cbind(pairs_dt, out)
  out[, Panel := panel]
  out[, N_samples := length(samples)]
  out[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]      # FDR inside each panel
  out
}))
res[, Chromatin_label := label_map[Chromatin_set]]
res[, Estrogen_label  := label_map[Estrogen_set]]

# NEW: number of genes shared by each pair (from the pILC_03 output).
# match() keeps the row order of res, which the heatmap matrices rely on.
shared <- fread(cor_file)[, .(Chromatin_set, Estrogen_set, Shared_genes)]
res[, Shared_genes := shared$Shared_genes[
  match(paste(Chromatin_set, Estrogen_set), paste(shared$Chromatin_set, shared$Estrogen_set))]]
if (anyNA(res$Shared_genes)) stop("Shared_genes missing for some pairs; check cor_file.")

fwrite(res, file.path(table_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_correlations_all_and_cluster_wise.tsv"),
       sep = "\t", na = "")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NEW: main result table = pooled test (all 31 tumors)
# FDR < 0.05, no shared genes, positive rho
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pooled <- res[Panel == "All tumors"]
pooled_sig <- pooled[FDR < 0.05 & Shared_genes == 0]
setorder(pooled_sig, -Rho, FDR)             # repeats grouped by estrogen pathway

fwrite(pooled_sig[, .(Chromatin_label, Estrogen_label, Rho, P_value, FDR, Shared_genes)],
       file.path(table_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_pairs_FDR_overall_sig.tsv"), sep = "\t")

cat("Pairs tested:", nrow(pooled), "\n")
cat("FDR < 0.05 (all tumors):", sum(pooled$FDR < 0.05), "\n")
cat("  of these sharing genes (flagged '#'):", sum(pooled$FDR < 0.05 & pooled$Shared_genes > 0), "\n")
cat("Reported pairs (FDR < 0.05, no shared genes):", nrow(pooled_sig),
    "| positive:", sum(pooled_sig$Rho > 0), "| negative:", sum(pooled_sig$Rho < 0), "\n")
cat("Unique chromatin pathways:", uniqueN(pooled_sig$Chromatin_set),
    "| unique estrogen pathways:", uniqueN(pooled_sig$Estrogen_set), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Heatmap: one fixed order for every panel, taken from the all-tumor result
# ------------------------------------------------------------
rho_all <- matrix(res[Panel == "All tumors", Rho], nrow = length(chr_ids),
                  ncol = length(est_ids), byrow = TRUE,
                  dimnames = list(chr_ids, est_ids))
chr_order <- rownames(rho_all)[hclust(dist(rho_all))$order]
est_order <- colnames(rho_all)[hclust(dist(t(rho_all)))$order]

res[, Chromatin_label := factor(Chromatin_label, levels = rev(label_map[chr_order]))]
res[, Estrogen_label  := factor(Estrogen_label,  levels = label_map[est_order])]
res[, Panel_label := factor(paste0(Panel, " (n = ", N_samples, ")"),
                            levels = unique(paste0(panel_levels, " (n = ", res[match(panel_levels, Panel), N_samples], ")")))]

# * = FDR < 0.05 and no shared genes; # = FDR < 0.05 but shared genes; + = nominal P < 0.05 only
res[, Mark := fifelse(FDR < 0.05 & Shared_genes == 0, "*",
              fifelse(FDR < 0.05, "#",
              fifelse(P_value < 0.05, "+", "")))]

cor_plot <- ggplot(res, aes(Estrogen_label, Chromatin_label, fill = Rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Mark), size = 3, vjust = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Panel_label) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman rho") +
  labs(title = "Chromatin vs estrogen pathway scores: whole cohort and within each cluster",
       subtitle = paste0("* FDR < 0.05 (no shared genes);  # FDR < 0.05 but gene sets share genes;  ",
                         "+ nominal P < 0.05 only. FDR computed within each panel; cluster panels are descriptive."),
       x = "Estrogen pathways", y = "Chromatin pathways") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_plot(cor_plot, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_correlation_all_and_cluster_wise",
          w = 24, h = max(9, 0.2 * length(chr_ids) + 4))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NEW: scatter plots of every pooled-significant pair (repeats allowed),
# grouped by estrogen pathway, one pooled regression line per panel
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(pooled_sig) > 0) {
  sc <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pooled_sig)), function(i) {
    ttl <- paste0(pooled_sig$Chromatin_label[i], "\nvs ", pooled_sig$Estrogen_label[i],
                  "\nrho = ", round(pooled_sig$Rho[i], 2),
                  ", FDR = ", signif(pooled_sig$FDR[i], 2))
    data.table(Pair = ttl, Cluster = meta$Cluster,
               Chromatin_score = score_mat[pooled_sig$Chromatin_set[i], meta$Sample],
               Estrogen_score  = score_mat[pooled_sig$Estrogen_set[i],  meta$Sample])
  }))
  sc[, Pair := factor(Pair, levels = unique(Pair))]   # keeps the grouped order

  sc_plot <- ggplot(sc, aes(Chromatin_score, Estrogen_score)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Cluster), size = 2.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.8) +  # pooled line
    facet_wrap(~ Pair, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
    labs(title = "Chromatin vs estrogen pathway scores across all 31 tumors",
         subtitle = "Spearman, FDR < 0.05 across 400 pairs; shared-gene pairs excluded; cluster colours for display only",
         x = "Chromatin pathway ssGSEA score", y = "Estrogen pathway ssGSEA score") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

  save_plot(sc_plot, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_pairs_FDR_overall_scatter",
            w = 15, h = max(6, 3.6 * ceiling(nrow(pooled_sig) / 3)))
}
# ============================================================
# TABLE: consistency across clusters (best pairs to report)
# ============================================================
cl <- res[Panel != "All tumors"]
cl[, Cl := gsub(" ", "", as.character(Panel))]
wide <- dcast(cl, Chromatin_set + Estrogen_set ~ Cl, value.var = c("Rho", "P_value"))
rho_cols <- paste0("Rho_Cluster", 1:3)
wide[, Mean_rho_clusters := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = rho_cols]
wide[, Min_rho_clusters  := do.call(pmin, .SD), .SDcols = rho_cols]
wide[, Positive_in_all_clusters := Min_rho_clusters > 0]
wide[, Clusters_with_P_lt_0.05 := rowSums(.SD < 0.05), .SDcols = paste0("P_value_Cluster", 1:3)]

all_tbl <- res[Panel == "All tumors", .(Chromatin_set, Estrogen_set, Rho_all = Rho,
                                        P_all = P_value, FDR_all = FDR)]
shared  <- fread(cor_file)[, .(Chromatin_set, Estrogen_set, Shared_genes)]
wide <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = c("Chromatin_set", "Estrogen_set"), all.x = TRUE),
               list(wide, all_tbl, shared))
wide[, Chromatin_label := label_map[Chromatin_set]]
wide[, Estrogen_label  := label_map[Estrogen_set]]
setorder(wide, FDR_all, -Min_rho_clusters)
fwrite(wide, file.path(table_dir, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_consistency_across_clusters.tsv"),
       sep = "\t", na = "")

cat("Pairs tested:", nrow(wide), "\n")
cat("Significant across the cohort (FDR < 0.05):", sum(wide$FDR_all < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Positive in all three clusters:", sum(wide$Positive_in_all_clusters), "\n")
cat("Both (cohort FDR < 0.05, positive in all clusters, no shared genes):",
    sum(wide$FDR_all < 0.05 & wide$Positive_in_all_clusters & wide$Shared_genes == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ============================================================
# Scatter plots of the best pairs (one regression line per cluster)
# ============================================================
best <- head(wide[FDR_all < 0.05 & Positive_in_all_clusters == TRUE & Shared_genes == 0], 6)
if (nrow(best) > 0) {
  sc <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(best)), function(i) {
    ttl <- paste0(best$Chromatin_label[i], "\nvs ", best$Estrogen_label[i],
                  "\nall: rho = ", round(best$Rho_all[i], 2),
                  "; clusters: ", round(best$Rho_Cluster1[i], 2), " / ",
                  round(best$Rho_Cluster2[i], 2), " / ", round(best$Rho_Cluster3[i], 2))
    data.table(Pair = ttl, Cluster = meta$Cluster,
               Chromatin_score = score_mat[best$Chromatin_set[i], meta$Sample],
               Estrogen_score  = score_mat[best$Estrogen_set[i],  meta$Sample])
  }))
  sc[, Pair := factor(Pair, levels = unique(Pair))]

  sc_plot <- ggplot(sc, aes(Chromatin_score, Estrogen_score, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ Pair, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
    labs(title = "Best-supported chromatin vs estrogen pathway pairs",
         x = "Chromatin pathway ssGSEA score", y = "Estrogen pathway ssGSEA score") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
  save_plot(sc_plot, "chromatin_vs_estrogen_best_pairs_scatter", w = 13, h = 12)
} else {
  message("No pair met all criteria; relax the filter or inspect the consistency table.")
}
```

```{r}
##   Leading-edge genes of the one estrogen pathway that differs between
##   RNA clusters (Kruskal-Wallis FDR < 0.05), shown as a heatmap with a
##   cluster bar on top.
set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(data.table)
  library(fgsea)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

# ----------------------------
# Paths (fixed names, no dates)
# ----------------------------
input_dir   <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/VST_data_GENCODEv47"
count_file  <- file.path(input_dir, "htseq_raw_counts_with_gene_names.csv")
annot_file  <- file.path(input_dir, "gene_annotation_from_GTF.tsv")
c5_gmt_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"

base_dir  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Chromatin_Estrogen_pathway_scores"
table_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "tables")
plot_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "plots")

meta_file   <- file.path(table_dir, "cluster_metadata.tsv")
global_file <- file.path(table_dir, "cluster_global_tests.tsv")
score_file  <- file.path(table_dir, "ssGSEA_scores.tsv")
for (f in c(count_file, annot_file, c5_gmt_file, meta_file, global_file, score_file)) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing: ", f)
}

n_max_genes    <- 60
cluster_colors <- c("Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77", "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02", "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3")

# ----------------------------
# 1. The one significant estrogen pathway
# ----------------------------
gt  <- fread(global_file)
sig <- gt[Family == "Estrogen" & FDR < 0.05]
if (nrow(sig) != 1) stop("Expected exactly 1 significant estrogen set, found ", nrow(sig))
set_id    <- sig$Set
set_label <- sub(" \\[GO\\]$", "", sig$Label)
cat("Pathway:", sig$Label, "| FDR =", signif(sig$FDR, 3), "\n")

gmt      <- strsplit(readLines(c5_gmt_file), "\t")
gmt_sets <- setNames(lapply(gmt, function(v) toupper(v[-(1:2)])), vapply(gmt, `[`, character(1), 1))
if (!(set_id %in% names(gmt_sets))) stop("Set not found in GMT: ", set_id)
set_genes <- gmt_sets[[set_id]]

# ----------------------------
# 2. Clusters and target cluster (highest median pathway score)
# ----------------------------
meta <- fread(meta_file)
meta[, Cluster := factor(Cluster, levels = names(cluster_colors))]

sc <- fread(score_file)
score_row <- as.numeric(sc[Set == set_id, meta$Sample, with = FALSE])
target_cluster <- names(which.max(tapply(score_row, meta$Cluster, median)))
cat("Target cluster:", target_cluster, "\n")

# ----------------------------
# 3. DESeq2 (ranking only): target cluster vs the other two
# ----------------------------
count_dt <- fread(count_file)
count_dt <- count_dt[!grepl("^__", Gene)]
cm <- as.matrix(count_dt[, meta$Sample, with = FALSE])
rownames(cm) <- count_dt$Gene
storage.mode(cm) <- "integer"

coldata <- data.frame(
  Group = factor(ifelse(meta$Cluster == target_cluster, "Target", "Rest"), levels = c("Rest", "Target")),
  Cluster = meta$Cluster, row.names = meta$Sample)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(cm, coldata, design = ~ Group)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", quiet = TRUE)
res <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "Target", "Rest"))),
                     keep.rownames = "Gene")

annot <- fread(annot_file)
res[, Symbol := toupper(annot$gene_symbol[match(Gene, annot$Gene)])]
res <- res[!is.na(Symbol) & !grepl("^ENSG[0-9]+", Symbol) & !is.na(stat)]
setorder(res, -baseMean)
res <- res[!duplicated(Symbol)]

# Blind VST for the heatmap values
vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE))
expr <- vst_mat[res$Gene, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(expr) <- res$Symbol

# ----------------------------
# 4. fgsea on this one pathway -> leading edge
# ----------------------------
ranks <- sort(setNames(res$stat, res$Symbol), decreasing = TRUE)
pathway <- setNames(list(intersect(set_genes, names(ranks))), set_id)
cat("Genes in set:", length(set_genes), "| in ranking:", length(pathway[[1]]), "\n")

set.seed(42)
fg <- as.data.table(fgseaMultilevel(pathways = pathway, stats = ranks,
                                    minSize = 10, maxSize = 500, eps = 0, nproc = 1))
if (nrow(fg) == 0) stop("fgsea returned no result for this pathway.")
print(fg[, .(pathway, size, NES, pval, padj)])

leading <- fg$leadingEdge[[1]]
cat("Leading-edge genes:", length(leading), "\n")
if (fg$NES < 0) message("NES is negative: the leading edge is enriched in the OTHER clusters, not ", target_cluster)

lead_dt <- res[Symbol %in% leading, .(Symbol, baseMean, log2FoldChange, stat, pvalue)]
setorder(lead_dt, -stat)                 # ranking only; not drawn on the figure
fwrite(lead_dt, file.path(table_dir, "response_to_estradiol_leading_edge_genes.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(fg[, .(pathway, size, NES, pval, padj, leading_edge_size = length(leading),
              leading_edge = paste(leading, collapse = ";"))],
       file.path(table_dir, "response_to_estradiol_fgsea_result.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ----------------------------
# 5. Heatmap: leading-edge genes, cluster bar on top only
# ----------------------------
shown <- if (fg$NES < 0) tail(lead_dt$Symbol, n_max_genes) else head(lead_dt$Symbol, n_max_genes)
if (fg$NES < 0) shown <- rev(shown)      # keep the most enriched gene at the top

col_order <- meta[order(Cluster), Sample]
cl_vec    <- meta$Cluster[match(col_order, meta$Sample)]

mat <- t(scale(t(expr[shown, col_order, drop = FALSE])))
mat[!is.finite(mat)] <- 0
mat[mat > 2.5]  <- 2.5
mat[mat < -2.5] <- -2.5

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat, name = "Gene Z-score",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = cl_vec,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(Cluster = cl_vec, col = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
                                     annotation_name_side = "left"),
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  border = TRUE,
  column_title = paste0(set_label, ": leading-edge genes (", target_cluster, " vs other clusters)")
)

h_in <- max(6, 0.18 * nrow(mat) + 3)
for (ext in c("pdf", "png")) {
  f <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0("response_to_estradiol_leading_edge_heatmap.", ext))
  if (ext == "pdf") pdf(f, width = 9, height = h_in) else png(f, width = 9, height = h_in, units = "in", res = 300)
  draw(ht, merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 8, 6, 4), "mm"))
  dev.off()
}

message("Done. Genes shown: ", nrow(mat), " of ", length(leading), " leading-edge genes")
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
table_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Chromatin_Estrogen_pathway_scores/tables"

# 1. Pairwise results already computed (FDR is across the 10 estrogen sets, per comparison)

print(pw[Label %like% "Response to estradiol \\[GO\\]",
         .(Comparison, Median_A, Median_B, P_value, FDR)])

# 2. Cluster 3 vs the other two pooled, on the pathway score
sc   <- fread(file.path(table_dir, "ssGSEA_scores.tsv"))
meta <- fread(file.path(table_dir, "cluster_metadata.tsv"))
row  <- sc[Label %like% "Response to estradiol \\[GO\\]"]
x    <- as.numeric(row[, meta$Sample, with = FALSE])
is3  <- meta$Cluster == "Cluster 3"

w <- wilcox.test(x[is3], x[!is3], exact = FALSE)
cat("Median Cluster 3:", round(median(x[is3]), 3),
    "| median others:", round(median(x[!is3]), 3),
    "| Wilcoxon P =", signif(w$p.value, 3), "\n")
```
